description: This file defines a `SubmissionService` class responsible for managing the lifecycle of data product submissions within a backend API. It includes methods for creating and retrieving submissions, ensuring minimal test submissions, and updating submission states. The class interacts with a database, other services like `AuditService`, `DraftService`, and `AuthService`, and manages workflow states along with audit logging.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service for submission lifecycle and state management, including creation, retrieval, and state updates.

methods.name: None ensure_minimal_submission_for_tests(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Creates minimal test submissions and related draft entries for deterministic testing purposes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_submission( self, draft_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates a new submission record from a draft and queues a validation job, with audit logging.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_submission(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches submission details by ID from the database.

methods.description: Updates the state of a submission and logs the change via an audit event.
